text: Free horror casino demo: a slot machine is your weapon, and a creepy rabbit runs the table.
Every spin chains symbols into combos, and bigger combos beat the gamblers you duel.
Between rounds you buy new symbols and chips in a lucky shop, like a deckbuilder.
Best moment in the trailer: a chain so big the score cracks the screen.
The catch? The enemies you're supposedly fighting barely show up on the board.
There's PvP too. The demo is about four gigs installed, in six languages, and all three reviews so far are positive.
Think Luck be a Landlord, with Inscryption's creepy vibe.
Worth a dip if you like your gambling haunted.
